blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Integers are the whole numbers and their negatives. They sit on a number line, and a strict order of operations makes every expression have one answer.

blocks.title: Sign rules
items: Same signs when multiplying or dividing: positive
Different signs when multiplying or dividing: negative
Subtracting a number: add its opposite

blocks.title: Order of operations
items: 3. Multiply and divide, left to right
4. Add and subtract, left to right

blocks.title: Primes, GCF and LCM
items: GCF: largest number that divides both
LCM: smallest number both divide into
GCF of 12 and 18 is 6; LCM of 4 and 6 is 12
